name: prof-20k-idle
description: 20 kHz Stopped-stream loss-free check: ~5 s of full-rate capture with a no-op stop at the end (the timeline must be non-empty; it used to be a start iq=0, but since the no-align startup redesign that engages the full cold-start sequencer whose ISR cost overlaps the capture tail and drops samples - the gate is about ring sizing at idle, not startup-path capture). Regression gate for the RTT up-ring size (4096 floor since the stack-to-CCM migration; 3072 measured 2.7% loss).
